description.value: Woody's Liquor Store is part of the long-established Woody's Pub & Liquor Store complex in Coquitlam, a community fixture since 1932. The store is known for its selection of BC VQA wines and local craft beers, and offers walk-in retail as well as online ordering with Uber Eats delivery. It operates alongside Woody's Pub and Brunette Cannabis Co. on the same property.
